safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(يسبّح للَّه ... في الأرض) its i'rab, in words and clauses, has been given [Note: in verse (1) of Sūrat al-Ṣaff in this part.]. (له) is attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الملك), and the second (له) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الحمد). (على كلّ) is attached to the khabar (قدير).
The clause «له الملك ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause «له الحمد ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause له الملك.
The clause «هو ... قدير» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause له الملك.

* Rhetoric:
Fronting (al-taqdīm): in the words of Allah the Exalted «لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ».
The two prepositional phrases are fronted so that their fronting indicates the restriction of sovereignty and praise to Allah, Mighty and Majestic: sovereignty in truth is His, because He is the originator of everything and its innovator, the One who sustains it and has dominion over it; and likewise praise, because the roots of blessings and their branches are from Him. As for the sovereignty of others, it is a delegation from Him and a charge; and their praise is a reckoning that the blessing of Allah passed through their hand.

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is a conjunction of ramification (tafrīʿiyya). (منكم) is attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كافر), and the second (منكم) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (مؤمن). (الواو) is a conjunction. (ما) is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.], and the interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (بصير).
The clause «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «منكم كافر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the ṣila clause, and the absence of a returning pronoun does no harm, since for what is conjoined by fāʾ the presence of the returning pronoun in one of the two clauses suffices.. and so it is in Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal.].
The clause «منكم مؤمن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to منكم كافر.
The clause «اللَّه.. بصير» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).

* Rhetoric:
Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): in the words of Allah the Exalted فَمِنْكُمْ كافِرٌ وَمِنْكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ.
Here he made an antithesis between the disbeliever and the believer; and in the preceding verse an antithesis occurred between the heavens and the earth.

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(بالحقّ) is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from السموات, and the bāʾ is of accompaniment. (الفاء) is a conjunction. (إليه) is attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (المصير).
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «صوركم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «أحسن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause صوركم.
The clause «إليه المصير» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(في السموات) is attached to an omitted ṣila of ما. The second and third (ما) are maṣdar particles [Note: or relative nouns with the returning pronoun omitted.]. (بذات) is attached to the khabar (عليم).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تسرّون) is in the position of an accusative direct object, and (ما تعلنون) is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the first. The clause «يعلم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يعلم (الثانية) » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «تسرّون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
The clause «تعلنون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second particle-type relative (ما).
The clause «اللَّه عليم» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.

safi-cedvel:5-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for reproachful interrogation. (قبل) is an adverbial noun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of a genitive, attached to (يأتكم). (الفاء) is a conjunction, and likewise (الواو). (لهم) is attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب).
The clause «لم يأتكم نبأ ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ذاقوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لهم عذاب ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ذاقوا.
6- The demonstrative in (ذلك) refers to the punishment. (بالبيّنات) is attached to a ḥāl from رسلهم. (الفاء) is a conjunction in the two places. (الهمزة) is for rhetorical, denying interrogation. (بشر) is the agent of an omitted verb on the pattern of ishtighāl, explained by the verb mentioned after it [Note: or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause mentioned after it.]. (الواو) is a conjunction in the two places and resumptive in the third place ... The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه كانت..) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).
The clause «ذلك بأنّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is causal.
The clause «كانت تأتيهم ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of anna [Note: the ism of anna is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).].
The clause «تأتيهم رسلهم ... » is in the position of an accusative khabar of كانت.
The clause «قالوا ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause كانت ...
The clause « (يهدينا) بشر ... » is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «يهدوننا ... » has no grammatical position; it is explicative.
The clause «كفروا ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause قالوا.
The clause «تولّوا ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause كفروا.
The clause «استغنى اللَّه ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause تولّوا.
The clause «اللَّه غني ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(استغنى): it has an iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its origin is استغني - with a vowelled yāʾ at its end - a yāʾ vowelled after a fatḥa that was turned into an alif.

safi-cedvel:7-7.t:
* I'rab:
(أن) is the lightened form of the heavy (أنّ), and its ism is an omitted pronoun, i.e.: "that they ..." And the (الواو) in (يبعثوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم لن يبعثوا..) is in the position of an accusative, filling the place of the two objects of زعم.
(بلى) is a response particle for affirming what is negated. (الواو) is the wāw of oath. (ربّي) is genitive by the wāw, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear". (اللام) is the lām of oath. (تبعثنّ) is an imperfect verb, nominative because it is free [of a governor], the sign of the nominative being the persistence of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of similar letters; the wāw that is dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the (نون) is the nūn of emphasis. (ثمّ) is for conjunction. (لتنبّؤنّ) is like لتبعثنّ. (ما) is a maṣdar particle - or a relative; and the interpreted maṣdar (ما عملتم) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تنبّؤنّ).
(الواو) is resumptive, and the demonstrative in (ذلك) refers to the resurrection and the reckoning. (على اللَّه) is attached to the khabar (يسير).
The clause «زعم الذين ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لن يبعثوا ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the lightened (أن).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «الجواب المقدّرة (ستبعثون) » is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «القسم المقدّرة ... » has no grammatical position; it is a resumption within the scope of the saying, corroborating the content of the saying.
The clause «تبعثنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the implied oath.
The clause «تنبّؤنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause تبعثنّ.
The clause «عملتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type or nominal (ما).
The clause «ذلك على اللَّه يسير» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Benefits:
- بلى..
It is a response particle, specific to negation, and it conveys its nullification, as in the words of Allah the Exalted in the very verse we are dealing with: (زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنْ لَنْ يُبْعَثُوا قُلْ بَلى وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ) and His words:
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظامَهُ؟ بَلى قادِرِينَ عَلى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنانَهُ and His words: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ؟ قالُوا بَلى and أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ؟ قالُوا بَلى. Ibn ʿAbbās and others said: Had they said "naʿam" (yes), they would have disbelieved. The reason: naʿam is a confirmation of the one who reports, whether by negation or affirmation.
For this reason a group of jurists said: if he says "Do I not have a thousand [owed] by you?" and he says "balā", it binds him; and if he says "naʿam", it does not bind him. Others said: it binds him in both cases, and they proceeded in that on the basis of custom, not language. The upshot: for an interrogative preceded by a negation, if you wish to answer it with affirmation, you say (بلى), as in the noble verses above; and if you wish to answer it with negation, you say:
"naʿam". So if it is said to you: "Do you not like swimming?", you say: balā, I like swimming, for affirmation; or naʿam, I do not like swimming, for negation.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis of an implied condition. (باللَّه) is attached to (آمنوا). (الواو) is a conjunction in the two places, and resumptive in the third place. (ما) is a maṣdar particle - or a relative whose returning pronoun is omitted. The clause «آمنوا ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if the matter is thus regarding the resurrection and the informing, then believe."
The clause «أنزلنا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «اللَّه ... خبير» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type or nominal (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون..) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (خبير).

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم) is a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر). (ليوم) is attached to (يجمعكم). (الواو) is resumptive, and a conjunction in the second and third places. (من) is a conditional noun in the position of a nominative mubtadaʾ. (باللَّه) is attached to (يؤمن). (يعمل) is a jussive imperfect verb conjoined to the protasis. (صالحا) is an accusative direct object [Note: it may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its description, with the direct object implied.]. (عنه) is attached to (يكفّر), in the sense of "lightens" - or "removes". (يدخله) is a jussive imperfect verb conjoined to the apodosis. (من تحتها) is attached to (تجري), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "beneath its trees". (خالدين) is an accusative ḥāl from the object pronoun in (يدخله). (فيها) is attached to (خالدين), and likewise the adverb (أبدا). The demonstrative in (ذلك) refers to the expiation of evil deeds and the entry into the Gardens ...
The clause « (اذكر) يوم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يجمعكم ... » is in the position of a genitive muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ذلك يوم ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause «من يؤمن باللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يؤمن باللَّه ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «يعمل ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يؤمن.
The clause «يكفّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of the condition, not joined by fāʾ.
The clause «يدخله ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
The clause «تجري ... » is in the position of an accusative naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «ذلك الفوز ... » has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
10- (الواو) is a conjunction in the two places. (بآياتنا) is attached to (كذّبوا). (خالدين) is an accusative ḥāl from أصحاب. (فيها) is attached to (خالدين). (الواو) is resumptive - or a conjunction. The specified object of censure is omitted, its implied form being "هي" (it), that is, the Fire.
The clause «الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause من يؤمن.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كذّبوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause كفروا.
The clause «أولئك أصحاب ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «بئس المصير» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: or in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl خالدين.].

* Morphology:
(9) التغابن: a regular maṣdar of the quinquiliteral تغابن, taken from الغبن, which is the loss of one's share, and it is borrowed from the people's mutual cheating (taghābun) in trade.. its pattern is تفاعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
The representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the words of Allah the Exalted ذلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغابُنِ.
التغابن is borrowed from the people's mutual cheating in trade, which is that some of them cheat others, because the fortunate take the places of the wretched, which these wretched would have taken had they been fortunate, and the wretched take the places of the fortunate, which these fortunate would have taken had they been wretched.
The art of mockery (fann al-tahakkum): in the verse is a mockery of the wretched, because their descending is not a cheating.
And in a ḥadīth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "There is no servant who enters Paradise but he is shown his seat in the Fire, had he done evil, so that he increases in gratitude; and there is no servant who enters the Fire but he is shown his seat in Paradise, had he done good, so that he increases in regret."

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) is a negation. (مصيبة) is genitive in form and nominative in position, the agent of أصاب, and its object is omitted, i.e.: "anyone". (إلّا) is for restriction. (بإذن) is attached to a ḥāl from مصيبة. (الواو) is a conjunction. (من يؤمن باللَّه) its i'rab has been given [Note: in verse (9) of this sūra.]. (الواو) is resumptive - or a ḥāl wāw. (بكل) is attached to the khabar (عليم).
The clause «أصاب ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «من يؤمن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «يؤمن باللَّه ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «يهد قلبه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of the condition, not joined by fāʾ.
The clause «اللَّه ... عليم» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: or in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the agent of يهدي.].

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive, and the second is a conjunction, and likewise (الفاء). (تولّيتم) is a past verb in the position of the jussive, being the protasis. (الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis. (إنّما) is a restrictive particle (kāffa) together with what it restricts (makfūfa). (على رسولنا) is attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (البلاغ).
The clause «أطيعوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أطيعوا (الثانية) » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «تولّيتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «إنّما على رسولنا البلاغ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the justification of the implied apodosis, i.e.: "if you turn away, there is no blame on Our Messenger, because the conveying is upon him."

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) is the lā of generic negation. (إلّا) is for exception. (هو) is a detached pronoun, a badal from the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar of لا. (الواو) is resumptive. (على اللَّه) is attached to (يتوكّل). (الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis of an implied condition. (اللام) is the lām of command, and the verb is jussive and was vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns..
The clause «اللَّه لا إله إلّا هو» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللَّه).
The clause «ليتوكّل المؤمنون» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if people put their trust in other than Allah, let the believers put their trust in Him.." The implied conditional clause is resumptive.

safi-cedvel:14-18.t:
* I'rab:
(من أزواجكم) is attached to the khabar of inna. (لكم) is attached to (عدوّا) [Note: or attached to a naʿt of (عدوّا).]. (الفاء) is a conjunction linking the effect to the cause. (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places. (الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis.
The clause «النداء ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ من أزواجكم ... عدوّا» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «احذروهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to a resumption that is an effect of what preceded, i.e.: "be aware, and beware of them."
The clause «تعفوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «تصفحوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «تغفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «إنّ اللَّه غفور» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, joined by fāʾ.
15- (إنّما) is a restrictive particle together with what it restricts. (الواو) is a conjunction in the two places. (عنده) is an accusative adverb attached to the preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أجر).
The clause «أموالكم ... فتنة» has no grammatical position; it is a resumption within the scope of the response to the vocative.
The clause «اللَّه عنده أجر» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أموالكم ... فتنة.
The clause «عنده أجر» is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللَّه).
16- (الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis of an implied condition. (ما) is a maṣdar, temporal particle. (الواو) is a conjunction in the four places..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما استطعتم) is in the position of an accusative adverb of time, attached to (اتّقوا), i.e.: "fear Allah for the duration of your capacity". (خيرا) is the khabar of an implied يكن together with its ism, i.e.: "spend, and the spending will be good for yourselves" [Note: this i'rab agrees with the interpretation of the verse in Ibn Kathīr, where it says: "Do good as Allah has done good to you; it will be better for you in this world and the next ..." As for Sībawayh, he made it a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "bring what is good for yourselves"; and the Kufans make it a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its description, i.e. "a good spending"..
or it is a direct object whose operator is أنفقوا, and the good (al-khayr) is wealth.] (لأنفسكم) is attached to (خيرا). (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of a nominative mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) is the connector of the apodosis. (هم) is a separating pronoun [Note: or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is المفلحون, and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]..
The clause «اتّقوا اللَّه ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if you rise to obedience, then fear Allah...."
The clause «استطعتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
The clause «اسمعوا ... » is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا ...
The clause «أطيعوا ... » is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا ...
The clause «أنفقوا ... » is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا ...
The clause « (يكن الإنفاق) خيرا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined by fāʾ.
The clause «من يوق ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the implied conditional clause [Note: or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.].
The clause «يوق ... » is in the position of a nominative khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «أولئك ... المفلحون» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, joined by fāʾ.
17- 18- (قرضا) is an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq [Note: this is according to the apparent form.. or it is a direct object, as it appears in the interpretation of Ibn Kathīr: "Whatever you spend of anything, He will replace it, and whatever you give in charity of anything, its reward is upon Him ..."]. (لكم) is attached to (يضاعفه), and the second (لكم) is attached to (يغفر). (شكور، حليم، عالم، العزيز، الحكيم) are khabars of the mubtadaʾ (اللَّه).
The clause «تقرضوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is a resumption within the scope of the response to the vocative.
The clause «يضاعفه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of the condition, not joined by fāʾ.
The clause «يغفر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
The clause «اللَّه شكور ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: or in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the agent of يضاعفه or يغفر ...].
